preconditions.description: The number of strings in the first sequence must be between 1 and 20.
The number of strings in the second sequence must be between 1 and 20.
The number of queries must be between 1 and 2020.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10 for s in s_list)
preconditions.description: Each string in the first sequence must have a length between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(t) <= 10 for t in t_list)
preconditions.description: Each string in the second sequence must have a length between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y <= 10**9 for y in queries)
preconditions.description: Each year in the queries must be between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join([s_list[(y - 1) % n] + t_list[(y - 1) % m] for y in queries])
postconditions.description: The output must be the concatenation of the corresponding strings from the sequences for each queried year.
